notes.title: Cultus Holiday Event!
notes.content:
Hey all,
This holiday season we're spicing Cultus up a little with a holiday themed update. The update brings about some minor big fixes and clarifies more on how the game works. Most importantly, [b]the game is going 50% off[/b], meaning this is [i]perfect for you and some friends to grab the game and get to trying out some multiplayer[/i]. Remember, if you find any [u]bugs[/u], [u]issues[/u] or have [u]recommendations[/u], [u]please make a community post[/u] and we will be sure to take it into consideration.

notes.title: The Halloween Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
Hi Guys!
I'm really proud to announce that today we are releasing [b]Cultus' Halloween Multiplayer Update![/b] This new update brings exactly what the title says, Multiplayer! Experience Cultus with up to 10 friends, but you all won't be together. Up to two of your friends can be [i]The Cult[/i]. In order to survive and win, The Survivors must collect a number of keys, while The Cult must prevent them by hunting them down! The map of Cultus has been adapted to fit for exciting, funny, and scary moments that are always player-generated.
[previewyoutube=Nkm961qBTZ0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Looking Ahead[/h1]
This is the first of many updates that we have plans for. New updates in the future will bring [b]new maps[/b], [b]monsters[/b], and [b]player skins[/b] to make the game a little more exciting and entertaining. Of course, if you find any bugs or have any suggestions be sure to report them in the community page on steam. We are working to find and fix the ones that we've noticed, but if you do find one try and provide a video or screenshot, as that greatly helps out.[u][b]Stay tuned guys, this is only the beginning![/b][/u]
